exposure: Need for Bellwether surgery (caesarean delivery, laparotomy, and external fixation of a fracture)
cohort: 887 households comprising 5944 community members in the Butembo and Katwa health zones in the North Kivu province of DRC
finding: Access to essential surgery is severely limited in the North Kivu province of the DRC, with a significant proportion of households needing surgery unable to access it due to financial constraints and distrust in the hospital system.
